shortDescription: Create or destroy a IONOS CLOUD Target Group.

options.name: algorithm
options.description: The balancing algorithm. A balancing algorithm consists of predefined rules with the logic that a load balancer uses to distribute network traffic between servers.  - **Round Robin**: Targets are served alternately according to their weighting.  - **Least Connection**: The target with the least active connection is served.  - **Random**: The targets are served based on a consistent pseudorandom algorithm.  - **Source IP**: It is ensured that the same client IP address reaches the same target.

options.name: health_check
options.description: Health check properties for target group.

options.name: http_health_check
options.description: HTTP health check properties for target group.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The forwarding protocol. Only the value 'HTTP' is allowed.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: target_group
options.description: The ID or name of the Target Group.

options.name: targets
options.description: Array of items in the collection.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
